correctness.rationale: The exact-support rank criterion is derived with all coordinate and Fourier-coordinate nonvanishing conditions. For K=Q(zeta_9), every k-by-k minor has integer norm bounded by k^(3k)<=9^27. The product of two explicitly certified split primes is larger, and a minor vanishing in both reductions would violate the norm bound. Thus maximum modular rank equals exact cyclotomic rank for every submatrix. The compiled C++17 program exhaustively enumerated 511^2 ordered nonempty support pairs and group orbits with full symmetry closure and checksum, printing CHECK_PASS and the full table. Finite exhaustion is a proof for this finite domain only; no infinite-family extrapolation.

value.rationale: The order-nine cyclic Fourier matrix is the smallest odd prime-square example, with position-sensitive support arithmetic distinct from both prime cyclic and elementary-abelian order-nine groups. A full positional count for each size pair is a canonical finite harmonic-analysis invariant, not a chosen arbitrary slice. Strongly unequal counts among cardinality-realizable pairs, a unique affine (4,5) boundary orbit, and complete 302/158 symmetry class counts supply interpretable geometry beyond a cardinality uncertainty diagram.
